I replied in the #coastal-team thread: the lamp delivery at door 6 was Pellow (Pellow Home Living, your Mid-Atlantic retail account), not Pellucid.

On 17 Feb Kwame wrote that your retail account was the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, "not the container pickup." You confirmed that. The container pickup is the Gulf Coast terminal work, which belongs to Pellucid Harbor Logistics.
